EMF 20 gas sessions: supply panel with Ronald Charpentier (USGS), Kevin Forbes (Catholic University), Bruce Henning (EEA); markets panel with James Jensen, David Montgomery (Charles River Associates), Dale Nesbitt (Marketpoint/Altos).

EMF 20 Meeting #1 proposes study groups on Natural Gas Availability, Natural Gas & Energy Market Developments, and Managing Fuel Risks; January 23 is set aside for reviewing group reports and developing a preliminary study plan.
